release: Fixes a regression in 4.9.0: the SEO tool ran the audit but showed no graded result — only a one-line status. The graded summary now renders inline (indexability and canonical first, then titles and descriptions with their values, then structured data), above the full report. The SEO tool also gets the same URL field and Settings gear as every other tab, with Default scope and Page ceiling as saved defaults. No scoring change: no rule was added, removed or rescored, so a score from 4.10.0 is directly comparable to one from 4.9.0.
